brief: The canvas displays an intricate and continuous lattice formed by interlocking hexagonal tessellations. These complex, crystalline structures are marked by defined boundaries, across which visible electrical energy pulses. Stress fractures radiate throughout the network, pulsing with a vibrant, glowing electricity that highlights the immense tension within the continuous lattice. The entire pattern exhibits perpetual, subtle motion, giving the impression of a giant, stressed machine held just moments from catastrophic collapse.

statement: This sketch renders a dynamic, crystalline lattice structure composed of interlocking hexagonal tessellations that pulse with electrical energy. The visual effect is achieved through a combination of geometric animation and procedural stress fracture generation. Each hexagon subtly changes size and color over time, while glowing connections between adjacent structures create a sense of tension and perpetual motion. Electrical energy pulses radiate from random points across the lattice as stress fractures form and dissipate, creating an impression of immense pressure building toward a catastrophic collapse. The entire scene slowly rotates to emphasize its mechanical nature and continuous strain.
